prompt:

Use thin projection lines linking each small plan view to its corresponding main grill. These views are not additional cooking apparatus; they are drafting views of the same two arrangements. No photorealism, no engraving, no dense shading, no blue blueprint, no yellow paper. Red #7b251b ONLY on heat arrows. Thin contour hierarchy: objects black, construction guides gray, heat red.
Exact Spanish labels: "CALOR DIRECTO", "CALOR INDIRECTO", "BRASAS BAJO EL ALIMENTO", "BRASAS A LOS LADOS", "VISTA EN PLANTA", "SECCIÓN A–A", and small footer "ESQUEMA CONCEPTUAL · SIN ESCALA". No invented dimensions, numeric measurements, temperatures, logo or branding. Engineering illustration, NOT a fabrication drawing or assembly manual. Clear spacious landscape 3:2 composition.
